alert_history.paper_title: EdgeMesh: A Distributed Edge Computing Framework for IoT Applications
alert_history.paper_author: Jiannong Cao, Yuvraj Sahni, Zhiyuan Yin
alert_history.research_problem: Centralized edge orchestrators suffer from single points of failure and bandwidth bottlenecks under dense IoT micro-clouds.
alert_history.approach: Decentralized mesh-based coordination where edge devices collaborate peer-to-peer to schedule microservices dynamically.
alert_history.key_contribution: Formulated distributed work-stealing and task offloading protocols reducing end-to-end task delay by 34% without central server.
alert_history.why_it_matters_for_edge: Direct blueprint for decentralized edge-cloud collaboration and peer-to-peer computation offloading.
alert_history.research_trajectory: Prof. Jiannong Cao has shaped modern systems research. Trajectory: Evolved from classical distributed algorithms and mobile ad-hoc networks (2000s) to wireless sensor networks and cloud computing (2010s), and currently leads research in Edge Intelligence, decentralized collaborative inference, and AIoT.
alert_history.what_to_read_next: Follow up with 'Collaborative Edge AI Inference with Dynamic Early-Exit Networks' for current extensions.
alert_history.potential_phd_alignment: Potential PhD Topics: Decentralized Peer-to-Peer Edge Orchestration without Central Coordinator; Adaptive Early-Exit Deep Neural Inference over Heterogeneous Edge Mesh Nodes.
alert_history.application_action_today: Review Prof. Jiannong Cao's official lab website and note current group members and active projects.
alert_history.scholarship_connection: PolyU Presidential PhD Fellowship Scheme (PPPFS) (Annual cash award of HK$40,000 + full tuition waiver + monthly stipend). Supervisor endorsement significantly strengthens departmental ranking.
alert_history.next_action: Tomorrow (Day 2): Deconstruct foundational publication 'EdgeMesh: A Distributed Edge Computing Framework for IoT Applications'.

alert_history.paper_title: Collaborative Edge AI Inference with Dynamic Early-Exit Networks
alert_history.paper_author: Zhiyuan Yin, Jiannong Cao, Shenglong Yu
alert_history.research_problem: Running heavy deep neural networks on energy-constrained IoT edge devices causes extreme latency and battery exhaustion.
alert_history.approach: Adaptive early-exit backbone with progressive multi-device feature sharing across edge clusters.
alert_history.key_contribution: Achieved 92% Top-1 accuracy while cutting average inference latency by 52% across heterogeneous edge nodes.
alert_history.why_it_matters_for_edge: Direct alignment with Edge AI, model compression, and split computing research questions.
alert_history.research_trajectory: Progression: Moved from general distributed networking toward Edge Computing, Edge AI, Distributed Systems.
